TADA_remnantphaseships.job_description:
A recent salvaging expedition has been lost with the few survivors that straggled back telling tales of a fleet of automated ships that was barely caught by sensors before the disastrous engagement that has cost our corporation dearly.
With what little data was brought back, we have determined that these ships are capable of entering phase space and are also utilizing weapons unknown to us, making the fleet an unignorable threat for future expeditions in the area.
We are offering a notable sum for the removal of this threat to help secure the area for future expeditions.
TADA_remnantphaseships.job_comm_reply: There is no reply from the automated ships as your first officer notes the odd weaponry these already unusual drone ships have equipped.
TADA_remnantphaseships.job_intel_success: Footage and sensor logs confirming the takedown of the automated phase fleet is sent to the contracting corporation and your payment is sent in short order.
TADA_remnantphaseships.job_intel_failure: Dismayed at the lack of progress, the contracting corporation has closed the contract.
TADA_remnantphaseships.job_intel_expired: Dismayed at the lack of progress, the contracting corporation has closed the contract.
